definitions: A brief, high-level overview or summary of the methodologies, techniques, or approaches used in a particular project, study, or process at a specific point in time.
A concise document or presentation that captures the essential elements of the methods employed, often used for quick reference or communication.
examples: The project manager requested a Methods Snapshot for the quarterly review.
We included a Methods Snapshot in the appendix of the research paper.
The team presented a Methods Snapshot to the stakeholders.
